decls.name: Account
decls.docs: A NexusBank financial account.

decls.name: AccountNotActive
decls.docs: The account is frozen or closed and cannot be changed.

decls.name: AccountSummary
decls.docs: Portfolio overview across all accounts of a user.

decls.name: CreateAccountInput
decls.docs: Payload to open a new account.

decls.name: Statement
decls.docs:
An account together with its latest transactions.
`Transaction` comes from the `transactions` service, which in turn imports `Account`.

decls.name: Card
decls.docs: A payment card linked to an account.

fields.name: last4
fields.docs: The last four digits. The full number is never exposed.

decls.name: CardCancelled
decls.docs: The card is cancelled and cannot be changed.

decls.name: RequestCardInput
decls.docs: Requests a new card for an account.

decls.name: EmailTaken
decls.docs: The email address is already registered.

decls.name: LoginInput
decls.docs: Credentials for email and password authentication.

decls.name: RefreshInput
decls.docs: Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair.

decls.name: RegisterInput
decls.docs: New user registration payload.

decls.name: TokenPair
decls.docs: A JWT access token and its refresh token.

fields.name: expiresIn
fields.docs: Seconds until the access token expires.

decls.name: UpdateProfileInput
decls.docs: Fields a user may change on their own profile.

decls.name: User
decls.docs: A registered NexusBank user.

decls.name: Notification
decls.docs: A user-facing notification.

decls.name: NotificationPreferences
decls.docs: Per-category opt-in settings.

decls.name: UpdatePreferencesInput
decls.docs: Partial update of the preferences.

decls.name: HistoryFilter
decls.docs: Filters for the transaction history.

decls.name: InsufficientFunds
decls.docs: The source account does not hold enough money.

decls.name: Transaction
decls.docs: A single financial transaction.

decls.name: TransferInput
decls.docs: Initiates a transfer to another IBAN.

decls.name: TransferReceipt
decls.docs:
The result of a transfer: the new transaction and the debited account.
`Account` comes from the `accounts` service, which in turn imports `Transaction`.

services.name: Accounts
services.docs: Bank account management: open, view, freeze and close accounts.

endpoints.name: listAccounts
endpoints.docs: Lists the accounts of the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: getStatement
endpoints.docs: The account with its latest transactions, fetched from the transactions service.

endpoints.name: freezeAccount
endpoints.docs: Blocks all future transactions on an account.

services.name: Cards
services.docs: Payment card management: request, view, freeze and cancel.

endpoints.name: listCards
endpoints.docs: Lists the cards of the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: requestCard
endpoints.docs: Requests a new card linked to an account.

endpoints.name: freezeCard
endpoints.docs: Temporarily blocks all usage of a card.

services.name: Iam
services.docs: Identity and access management: authentication and user profiles.

endpoints.name: login
endpoints.docs: Authenticates and returns a token pair.

endpoints.name: refreshToken
endpoints.docs: Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair.

endpoints.name: updateProfile
endpoints.docs: Updates the name or phone of the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: listNotifications
endpoints.docs: Lists the notifications of the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: getHistory
endpoints.docs: Paginated transaction history of an account.

endpoints.name: transfer
endpoints.docs: Moves money to another IBAN. The accounts service is asked to check the source account.
